name: navigator-session-isolation-decision
body: Each `task` dispatch to a reviewer or implementer subagent is a fresh isolated session. The sole resume is the tight hand-back loop: an implementer returns to the navigator for a scan, verify, or `apg_review_action`, and the navigator resumes that same session only to finish that same task (`apg_plan_done` + `apg_plan_note`). Resuming a session to start a new task is forbidden, and reviewer sessions stay un-resumed. `requirements.requirement.navigator-session-isolation` drives `domain.entity.subagent-session-isolation`, which is realised by `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` (implemented by `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`) and `solution.component.navigator-isolation-coherence-test` (implemented by `rust.main_e2e.e2e.coordinator_agent_carries_review_action_and_dispatch_prose`). The law `requirements.constraint.subagent-sessions-isolated` governs session isolation, and `requirements.constraint.navigator-cadence-stated` governs the cadence ordering.
